items.title: fix(state): keep completed retained agent stores out of startup upgra…
items.summary: fix(state): keep completed retained agent stores out of startup upgrade (#200284) Startup state upgrade no longer selects or copies agent stores whose deletion completed with files retained (deletion journal: cleanup_completed=1, delete_files=0). Their older schema made the startup migration chain fail. That triggered the generic-copy fallback, which rewrote the retained database or exited with "no such module: vec0" and crash-looped the Gateway. Active agents, shared state and pending deletions keep their existing validation. Proof: real-SQLite red/green regression (with a vec0 table); exact-head CI green; live Crabbox upgrade from npm 2026.11.4. On base the chain failed and fell back to the generic copy, rewriting the retained store. On the PR head the migration chain succeeded, /readyz was ready, and the retained store and seal were byte-identical. Fixes #200271 Reported-by: @hannesrudolph Co-authored-by: steipete

items.summary: fix(templates): authorize new-agent rollback writes (#200300) Allow the existing guarded rollback to remove only the agent Template Add created when local runtime activation fails before availability. Preserve the current agent/workspace ownership checks and later retained-agent behavior. Carry forward Anmol's fix from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196054 with a current-boundary real-writer regression and stable-ID replan proof. Co-authored-by: Anmol Bhardwaj
